item.tib: ma tshogs las kyis rtags bsgrub
item.coloph: khro bo rin chen spyi spungs zhes bya ba/ 'chi med gtsug phud kyi thugs bcud/ bar do 'phrang sgrol chen po/ log lta srog gi spu gri zhes bya ba/ rig 'dzin kun gyi thugs mdzod bskul nas/ slob dpon stang chen dmu tsha gyer med/ yum cig mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma'i (mas)dben gnas lung bzang brag dmar du/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bsnyon (smon) pa snying med po/ mi shig rdo rje rtsal la bsnyan (snyan) du brgyud/ mtshan ldan bla mas rab bskul nas/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyongs srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge bas 'gro kun zhi khro'i zhal mthong shog 'di bris dge ba'i mthu dpal las brtan (la brten) nas/ bstan pa'i rgyal po g.yung drung bon 'di dag phyogs bcu kun tu dar cing rgyas par shog/
